**Reflections on Q4 (Explainability):**
Q4's trade-off phrasing was hard; I struggled to weigh "identifying more students" against "understanding why." The definitions of "moderate" vs. "low" explainability felt blurry in practice. **Reflections on Q6 & Q7 (Intervention):**

The clearest design priority is combining personalized outreach with voluntary meetings. Generic emails are easy to ignore or misinterpret. A tailored invitation respects my specific context and reduces the anxiety of "being caught."
